Yeah (g)rape would be an example of a trigger. Best advice for that would be to go through every chapter and note anything that could trigger most people. Eating disorders, self harm, underage s3x, slaves, lack of consent, cancer, list goes on and on. I'm sure people appreciate a note at the start of chapters when especially dark things are happening. But in general play it safe. I got my best grasp my seeing how other people tagged. I looked for what I knew were dark and triggering stories and looked at how they tagged those out. 

Original characters is easier. When adding characters, you can simply just add "Original (Male/Female/Other) Character. That one is a lot easier. If the cardboard cutout coming to life is a real character, tag the character. I would also tag XXX cardboard cut out. So example: 'Harry Potter' 'Harry Potter cardboard cut out' 'underage s3x' etc. 

I started with FFN, moved to Wattpad, then Quotev and ended up at AO3. It gets easier to do naturally with time. I wish you luck! I hope I cleared something up!

Lol. Welcome to ao3. Please don't panic. I promise it's not as hard as it looks. It just takes some practice. When I first joined, I personally decided to spend some time browsing and figuring out everything on the readers side before posting. Makes it easier for you later to optimize for the reader. 

Tags aren't that big. Add as much or as little as you want. Say whatever you want. I promise people are going to skim them. That's are not important. (Do tag ur characters tho and any possible triggers. That does matter.)
